description.p: Open Legato is a cross-platform sheet-music reader built for pianists and classical musicians. It provides zero-latency page flips, a reliable fullscreen performance mode, and high-quality PDF rendering.

ul.li: Library-based organisation — import PDFs as self-contained score files
Fullscreen performance mode with configurable touch buttons
Dual-page spread mode in landscape orientation
Repeat buttons to jump between sections (D.S., Coda, etc.)

screenshot.caption: Settings popup — toggle touch buttons, page numbers, bookmarks, and more
Editing a repeat button to jump between sections (D.S., Coda, etc.)

ul.li: Library-based storage — PDFs are imported into a managed library as non-destructive .olscore archives that keep annotations and settings alongside the original file.
Fullscreen performance mode with configurable touch buttons for one-handed page turns.
Repeat buttons and bookmarks for fast navigation between sections.
Dual-page spread mode that auto-activates in landscape orientation.
Disk-cached high-quality PDF rendering for instant page flips.
